import importlib.util, importlib.machinery, time, random, json
loader = importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader("runmod", "/app/submit/run")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader("runmod", loader)
R = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); loader.exec_module(R)
rng=random.Random(5)
FULL=(1<<128)-1
def trunc(v,b): return 0 if b<=0 else (v if b>=128 else v & (FULL ^ ((1<<(128-b))-1)))
fib=[]; seen=set()
while len(fib)<2048:
    l=rng.randint(1,128)
    v=trunc(rng.getrandbits(128),l)
    if (v,l) in seen: continue
    seen.add((v,l)); fib.append((v,l,rng.randint(0,65535)))
for (S,ms) in [(16,32),(16,8),(4,32)]:
    caps=[10**9]*S
    req={"op":"compile","fib":[{"prefix":R.fmt(v,l),"hop":h} for v,l,h in fib],"capacities":caps,"max_stride":ms}
    t=time.time(); img=R.handle_compile(req); dt=time.time()-t
    print("S",S,"ms",ms,"compile",round(dt,3),"status",img["status"],"nnodes",sum(len(s["nodes"]) for s in img["stages"]) if img["status"]=="ok" else None,"outlen",len(json.dumps(img)))
# lookup perf on big image
addrs=[R.fmt(rng.getrandbits(128)) for _ in range(20000)]
req={"op":"lookup","image":img,"addresses":addrs}
t=time.time(); res=R.handle_lookup(req); dt=time.time()-t
print("lookup 20000 time",round(dt,3),"status",res["status"])
PYEOF
cd /app && timeout 170 python3 test_perf.py
